Combines cosine similarity (pgvector) with lexical `ts_rank` (tsvector), each from an independent query, merged by weighted sum and cut off by the threshold (ADR 0080). `vectorAvailable: false` warns when the embedding provider did not respond and the search ran with only the lexical signal — it never pretends to have run the full hybrid.
